# Copilot Instructions

- **Workspace layout**: Desktop Electron app in [../desktop](../desktop), the whole product. CI in [workflows](workflows) runs the checks and tests on every pull request.
- **Desktop entrypoint**: Electron main bootstraps via [src/main/index.ts](../desktop/src/main/index.ts); DI container is [container.di.ts](../desktop/src/main/di/container.di.ts) with `autobind: true`, so classes annotated with `@injectable()` auto-register.
- **Module pattern**: Main-process logic lives in modules extending [LogModule](../desktop/src/main/modules/log.module.ts) for Winston logging; use constructor DI over singletons.
- **Logging decorator**: Functions annotated with `@log` / `@log.debug` (see [logs.utils.ts](../desktop/src/main/utils/logs.utils.ts)) emit enter/exit timing; pass `false` to silence args, arrays to limit, or a formatter fn.
- **Config & context**: `MainContextModule` builds per-user app folder under `%LOCALAPPDATA%/elytools` (or override with `REPERTOIREMONSISRA`), exposes `resourcesFolder` and `env` ([main.context.module.ts](../desktop/src/main/modules/context/main.context.module.ts)). Config is cached JSON at `<appFolder>/config/config.json` managed by [config.module.ts](../desktop/src/main/modules/config/config.module.ts) with defaults from [app.config.ts](../desktop/src/shared/config/app.config.ts) and migrations.
- **Window management**: `WindowModule` creates frameless main window with preload script, uses `WindowPositionModule` to persist bounds in config and revalidate against connected displays ([window.module.ts](../desktop/src/main/modules/window/window.module.ts), [window.position.module.ts](../desktop/src/main/modules/window/window.position.module.ts)). `getMainWindow()` assumes BrowserWindow id 1.
- **IPC contract**: Typed channels live in [ipc.handled.events.ts](../desktop/src/shared/ipc/ipc.handled.events.ts) (renderer→main) and [ipc.sent.events.ts](../desktop/src/shared/ipc/ipc.sent.events.ts) (main→renderer). Handlers are registered in [ipc.handler.ts](../desktop/src/main/ipc/ipc.handler.ts) and call DI modules. Prefer adding new channels there and keep types in shared package.
- **IPC sender helper**: `IpcModule` wraps `webContents.send` with retries until main window exists and mirrors full-screen toggle events ([ipc.module.ts](../desktop/src/main/modules/ipc.module.ts)). Use `sendIpcToMainContent` for main-window broadcasts.
- **Process orchestration**: [process.module.ts](../desktop/src/main/modules/process/process.module.ts) exposes `run(command, args, { signal, onStderr })`: no shell, arguments passed as they are, every running process killed when the app quits. The window cannot start a process: add a task-level IPC channel instead.
- **FFmpeg integration**: [ffmpeg.process.module.ts](../desktop/src/main/modules/process/ffmpeg.process.module.ts) runs system `ffmpeg/ffprobe` (no bundled binary): probe, analysis (XPSNR quality search), conversion, statistics tags. The encoder queue lives in the main process ([encoder-queue.module.ts](../desktop/src/main/modules/encoder/encoder-queue.module.ts), pipeline in [encoder.pipeline.ts](../desktop/src/main/modules/encoder/encoder.pipeline.ts)) and sends its status with the `encoder:status` event.
- **File dialog & fs ops**: [file.module.ts](../desktop/src/main/modules/file.module.ts) wraps Electron dialogs and `fs` for delete/mkdir/rename/lstat/temp-path; returns typed results used by renderer.
- **Updates**: [update.module.ts](../desktop/src/main/modules/update.module.ts) wires `electron-updater` with feed from [main.config.ts](../desktop/src/shared/config/main.config.ts); auto-download is disabled, download/quit/install triggered via IPC (`update:*` channels). Update checks run when main window shows and on renderer ready.
- **Request interception**: [interception.request.module.ts](../desktop/src/main/modules/request/interception.request.module.ts) strips restrictive headers and injects `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` based on requesting webContents; bound in `app.whenReady`.
- **Preload exposure**: [src/preload/index.ts](../desktop/src/preload/index.ts) exposes `preload.ipc.send/on` and config via contextBridge; renderer should call through `window.preload`.
- **Build/run (desktop)**: From [../desktop](../desktop), `pnpm dev` launches electron-vite (respects tsconfig path aliases via [electron.vite.config.ts](../desktop/config/electron.vite.config.ts)); `pnpm start` previews built bundle; `pnpm build` runs electron-vite build; `pnpm check` (vp: Oxfmt + Oxlint + types), `pnpm lint`, `pnpm fmt`, `pnpm test` available. Devtools installer loads React/Redux extensions in dev.
- **Logging output**: Log files stored under `<appFolder>/logs` with rotation; console logs remain enabled. Use `LogModule.getRendererLogger()` for renderer-side logging if needed.
- **Release scripts**: [scripts/release/release.ts](../desktop/scripts/release/release.ts) builds the Windows installer and the Linux packages and publishes the GitHub release (`pnpm release`, `pnpm release:dev`).

When adding features, follow the existing typed IPC contract, extend DI modules instead of ad-hoc singletons, and keep renderer/main shared types under `desktop/src/shared`. Ask if any area above feels underspecified so we can tighten guidance.
